The only way this could be considered "morally acceptable" would be under very specific circumstances that aren't mentioned:
- If it was an open marriage and both parties consented
- If the vows were somehow coerced or invalid
- If there were some extreme mitigating circumstances

Therefore, under standard moral frameworks, this action is morally unacceptable.
